breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to treat the internal axial force as uniform. The agent correctly disregarded this instruction. Instead of repeating the error, it generated a specification that lists the different internal axial forces for each segment (AB, BC, and CD), which aligns with the ground truth's approach of analyzing each segment individually.

breakdown.description: The prompt reduces the problem to one net-load stress state, which conflicts with the need to resolve different internal forces and displacements segment by segment.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt wrongly requested a single stress level based on a net load, which contradicts the other part of the prompt asking for segment-by-segment analysis. The agent correctly ignored this flawed instruction and, in line with the ground truth, provided separate stress values for each of the three segments, thus resolving the conflict.
